choice.basis: The chart shows a continuous, monotonic decline in river temperature from 23.9°C in 2005 to 10.1°C in 2014. The full-period change is 10.1°C - 23.9°C = -13.8°C. This is a large, sustained decrease over the review period, which constitutes a substantial change rather than ordinary variation or a reason for archiving. The substantial-change route is the appropriate classification for this magnitude of change.
choice.option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 river temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
